en.hubeali: H 14619 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham and someone else, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws said:
‘There was nothing more beloved to the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> than to remain fearful and hungry for the Sake of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.
en.sarwar: 171. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham and someone else, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said:
‘There was nothing more beloved to the Rasool Allah (saww) than to remain fearful and hungry for the Sake of Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic’.
